name: cache
description: Configures caching services by installing memcached and redis, setting a Redis password, creating a log directory, and cleaning up unwanted Redis config lines.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application, installing system packages, cloning the source repo, setting up a Python virtual environment, installing dependencies, provisioning PostgreSQL with a DB/user, creating an .env file, and configuring a systemd service.

name: nginx-multisite
description: Sets up Nginx with multiple SSL-enabled subdomains, hardens the host with fail2ban, ufw, sysctl, and SSH hardening, generates self-signed certificates per site, and deploys site-specific index.html files.
